hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; g="$HOME/.claude/global-memory"; [ -e "$g" ] || for s in "$d/global-memory" "$d/../claude-studio/global-memory" /home/user/claude-studio/global-memory; do [ -f "$s/installer.sh" ] && bash "$s/installer.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; done; [ -f "$d/memory/HANDOFF.md" ] && { echo "=== Mémoire du projet (memory/HANDOFF.md) ==="; sed -n 1,60p "$d/memory/HANDOFF.md"; echo "Mémoire globale : $g · détail et vérifications : /resume"; }; exit 0
